changes: Home themes itself by mode: dark mode wears the Netflix look, true black and red, and light mode wears the Prime Video look, white with Prime blue
Top chips reordered: Movies, Shows, New & Hot, Categories; Categories now opens the full list of shelves your chats hold, and each one opens its own page with a big banner

New shelves: HDR, Remastered, Foreign, series by genre, Running and Completed series, J-Drama, Top 10 in each language, star rows, 90s Classics, 2000s Hits, 2010s Hits, Hidden Gems, Trailers, Binge Ready, Malayalam Audio and Best Quality (4K with HDR)
Watch in Your Language: wide tiles on Home open a page for that language with its movies and shows together, and Search now opens with genre tiles and featured collections
Copies are grouped by level: UHD, HD+, HD, SD+ and SD for movies, where a 720p copy of 2 GB or more counts as HD+, and UHD, HD and SD for series
The My List button now carries a big plus, and it turns red when the title is on your list
Episodes change with no loading sheet in between, and the Home banner picks shuffle on every refresh
Two subtitles from the same file now play together, the subtitle and audio panels close with a tap outside, and a translation chosen in the player applies to that video only
Downmix to stereo is now off unless you turn it on in Settings
The MSone page gains a search by name box, a stuck MSone download ends with an honest message, and cam copies now hide by the post's caption too
The login pages and the setup steps were restyled, the cast page close button sits in its corner, and the Best badge is easier to read
